boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named campus settings for research, making, recreation, and student performances.

cards.title: Robert W. Van Houten Library
cards.subtitle: Central Avenue Building
cards.notes: Start here when a project needs both quiet focus and a group table; the building supports studying, research, computing, and browsing.
cards.short_summary: NJIT's main library combines individual and group-oriented academic space.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT identifies Van Houten Library as its primary facility for researching, studying, and browsing physical and online materials.
cards.source_title: Library Services | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Library policies and access rules apply; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Robert W. Van Houten Library, Central Avenue Building
cards.notes: Use a campus workstation when your laptop setup is not enough; NJIT lists the Information Commons as a computer lab with 100-plus workstations.
cards.short_summary: A library-based computer lab for academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that the Information Commons at Van Houten Library is a computer lab with more than 100 workstations.
cards.source_title: Library Services | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Located in Van Houten Library; check current library access and service availability.

cards.title: Collaborative Study Space
cards.subtitle: NJIT Library
cards.notes: Bring a project group here to spread out, compare work, and use the flexible setting designed for teams working through challenges together.
cards.short_summary: A flexible NJIT Library setting for project-based group work.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT describes the Collaborative Study Space as flexible space for students to work on projects and discover challenges and solutions.
cards.source_title: Library Services | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Check library access policies and current space availability before planning a group session.

cards.title: Leir Data Observatory
cards.subtitle: Robert W. Van Houten Library, Central Avenue Building
cards.notes: Choose this named library space for a data-focused work session; it is designated for students and faculty studying data science together.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated high-tech data-science learning space in the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT lists the Leir Data Observatory as a dedicated high-tech space for students and faculty to study data science mutually.
cards.source_title: Library Services | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Located in Van Houten Library; confirm current access and any equipment rules.

cards.entity_name: Barbara and Leonard Littman Architecture and Design Library
cards.title: Barbara and Leonard Littman Architecture and Design Library
cards.subtitle: Weston Hall
cards.notes: Browse architecture, art, and design resources in Weston Hall, then use the library as a starting point for visual and material research.
cards.short_summary: NJIT's branch library for architecture, art, and design resources.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT identifies Littman as a branch library in Weston Hall with architecture, art, and design books, journals, maps, drawings, media, and models.
cards.source_title: Library Services | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Library access policies apply; verify current hours before visiting Weston Hall.

cards.title: Materials Library
cards.subtitle: Barbara and Leonard Littman Architecture and Design Library, Weston Hall
cards.notes: Add a materials check to a design-research session: NJIT identifies this named collection as a place to examine material samples.
cards.short_summary: A named sample collection inside Littman Library.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that Littman Library houses the Materials Library, a collection of material samples.
cards.source_title: Library Services | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Located within Littman Library; check current library access policies before using the collection.

cards.title: Michael Mostoller Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Barbara and Leonard Littman Architecture and Design Library, Weston Hall
cards.notes: Use this named reading room as a focused stop while working with Littman's architecture, art, and design resources.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated reading room within NJIT's design-library setting.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT documents that the Michael Mostoller Reading Room was established at Littman Library in 2018.
cards.source_title: About Us | Barbara and Leonard Littman Architecture and Design Library
cards.access_notes: Located within Littman Library; confirm current building and library access before visiting.

cards.title: The Green
cards.subtitle: Next to the Campus Center
cards.notes: Take a break outdoors beside the Campus Center; NJIT specifically points to this green space for sitting under trees or tossing a frisbee.
cards.short_summary: A campus green space beside the Campus Center for outdoor downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT describes The Green as a patch of nature next to the Campus Center and suggests frisbee or relaxing under its trees.
cards.source_title: Why Live on Campus? | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted campus rules and event restrictions.

cards.entity_name: Lubetkin Field at J. Malcolm Simon Stadium
cards.title: Lubetkin Field at J. Malcolm Simon Stadium
cards.subtitle: NJIT athletic complex
cards.notes: Check the schedule for a soccer match or join an eligible intramural activity; the field hosts NJIT Division I soccer, PE, and intramurals.
cards.short_summary: NJIT's soccer field and a venue for physical education and intramural activity.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that Lubetkin Field is home to its men's and women's NCAA Division I soccer teams and also hosts PE classes and intramural sports.
cards.source_title: Why Live on Campus? | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Event, recreation, and spectator access can vary; consult current athletics or recreation schedules.

cards.title: Jim Wise Theatre
cards.subtitle: Kupfrian Hall
cards.notes: Look for the theatre department's student productions, or audition when announced; NJIT says all students are invited to audition for its productions.
cards.short_summary: NJIT's 425-seat playhouse for student theatre productions.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that Jim Wise Theatre hosts two student productions each year and that all NJIT students are invited to audition.
cards.source_title: Why Live on Campus? | New Jersey Institute of Technology
cards.access_notes: Production dates, ticketing, and audition details vary; consult current theatre announcements.
